topIssues.title: kona: orphaned sources/variant.rs in kona-derive references non-existent AsyncIterator and stale API
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
## Summary

`rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs` exists in the kona-derive sources directory but is **not included in `sources/mod.rs`** and is therefore dead code. The file references:

- A non-existent `AsyncIterator` trait (not defined anywhere in the kona codebase)
- An outdated `CalldataSource::new(chain, block_ref, batcher_address)` 4-argument API that no longer matches the current 2-argument API

The file appears to be a leftover from the workspace migration (commit `48a7a09b`). It will fail to compile if added to the module tree. There is no runtime impact, but the file is misleading to developers browsing the source.

## Location

[`rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/a8a2956e695f18f53309ff0c30587a2a42961329/rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs)

## Fix

Delete the file, or if there is a plan to restore it, update it to compile against the current API first.

## Context

Found during kona-node-vs-op-node conformance review (component: L1 Retrieval, finding LR-C05). Low priority — no runtime impact.

topPRs.title: feat: Add Kailua Contracts and Boundless Support Part 3
topPRs.author: hashcashier
topPRs.body:
**Description**
This PR introduces support for the new Kailua game type.

This is one of the PRs (opened not in order) aimed at enabling Kailua and Boundless support across the OP Stack’s onchain and offchain components, and will help advance the broader effort to generalize and standardize infrastructure for multiple zk proof systems.

Together with related efforts such as[ https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18277](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18277), this work contributes to standardizing key components and interfaces across game types, enabling a more modular and extensible approach to integrating multiple zk proof systems.

To follow-up supporting OP-Succinct Lite game type with Risc0 verifier and tests.

**Tests**
In a follow-up up PR

topPRs.title: op-dispute-mon: Add metrics for multi-supernode support
topPRs.author: pauldowman
topPRs.body:
<!--
Contributions welcome! See https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/.github/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
-->

**Description**

op-dispute-mon has support for using multiple supernodes. This adds metrics for errors and disagreements between the nodes.

This PR was fully AI generated (with a review and prompted changes).

  New monitors
  - SuperNodeEndpointErrorsMonitor - tracks endpoints with errors
  - SuperNodeEndpointErrorCountMonitor - tracks total error count across all endpoints
  - MixedSuperAvailability - detects when some endpoints return "not found" while others succeed
  - MixedSuperSafety - detects when endpoints disagree on safety assessment
  - DifferentSuperRootMonitor - detects when endpoints return different super roots

  Prometheus metrics (metrics.go)
  - supernode_endpoint_errors - number of endpoints with errors
  - supernode_endpoint_error_count - total errors across all endpoints
  - mixed_super_availability_games - games with inconsistent block availability
  - mixed_super_safety_games - games with inconsistent safety assessments
  - different_super_root_games - games where endpoints returned different super roots
